text:
Alex: Thanks everyone for coming to today's all-hands — quick follow-up thread where I'll capture clarifications, links, and owners. TL;DR: Dedicated GA target moved to May 15, Optimize will run 2 pilot workloads before GA, Private deploy onboarding has a new checklist. I'll post links and owners below.

Maya: thanks Alex — can you drop the slides + the Dedicated GA RFC here? :link: 

Alex: Slides: https://redwood.in/ah/slides-march-2026
Dedicated GA RFC: https://redwood.in/rfc/dedicated-ga-v2 (internal) :page_facing_up:

Sam: quick Q — who owns the autoscale SLO changes for Dedicated GA? I can take the infra work but need prod SLO + runbook owners.

Alex: Sam, can you lead infra-side autoscale + perf testing. @Raj will own the canary and rollback runbook.

Sam: Got it. I'll create ticket `RDW-2345` for autoscale changes + perf plan and link test matrix. ETA: draft by Wed.

Raj: I'll draft the canary rollback runbook and checklist. Will share first draft by EOD Friday and add steps for metric thresholds, alarm playbook, and rollback commands.

Maya: On Optimize suggestions in the Console — product asked for acceptance criteria. Priya, can you confirm how we want those surfaced?

Priya: Product will ship a lightweight banner + a “Recommendations” panel on the model detail page. Maya, please own copy + the QA checklist. Acceptance criteria: 1) banner appears only for >3% estimated token-savings, 2) suggestions link to one-click preview, 3) telemetry events fire for view/click.

Maya: Copy and QA checklist noted. I'll put a short spec in the product board and sync with DevEx for preview UX.

Tess: I'll schedule a 30m follow-up sync for owners next week. Tentative: Thu 10am PT. calendar-bot: Added to calendar — Thu Apr 1 10:00 AM PT.

Alex: Owners summary (I'll maintain this list):
- Autoscale + perf tests: Sam (`RDW-2345`)
- Canary & rollback runbook: Raj
- Recommendations UI + copy + QA: Maya
- Dedicated GA communications + partner checklist: Tess
- Exec checkpoints + SLA signoff: Priya

Alex: Action items for this thread: 1) Sam creates RDW ticket w/ test matrix (due Wed), 2) Raj posts runbook draft (due EOD Fri), 3) Maya posts UI spec + QA checklist (due Mon), 4) Tess shares calendar invite and comms plan (due Tue). I'll update this thread when items are complete.

Maya: small ask — can we get a short blurb (1-2 sentences) from Eng for the partner comms doc? Tess, can you collect and I can refine for copy.

Tess: Yep — I'll ping eng leads and collate blurbs into a single doc.

Alex: Great. If nobody objects, I'll mark this thread as the canonical place for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

Raj: No objections. Adding comments to the runbook once draft is up.

Sam: on it. Will link perf artifacts and a simple `curl` smoke-test snippet in the ticket for easy sanity checks.

Alex: Thanks all — closing for now; will bump when drafts land.
